result.text:
Berkshire trims bank stakes and adds to Delta in its latest holdings disclosure.

• The November 16 filing reports holdings as of September 30: Bank of America shares fell 5.7% to 455.9 million, while Capital One shares fell 61.7% to 1.15 million versus June 30.

• Delta Air Lines shares increased 12.4% to 64.45 million, showing a larger commitment to the airline during the quarter.

• Alphabet holdings were unchanged at 78.79 million Class A shares and 27.19 million Class C shares, so this filing does not show further buying of Google’s parent.

• A new Bending Spoons position contained 20.69 million shares, valued at about $689 million at quarter end.

• Apple remained the largest disclosed holding at about $75.9 billion, roughly 25% of the $304.2 billion reported portfolio.

• The changes suggest selective adjustments rather than a broad reshuffle, with Apple, American Express and Coca-Cola share counts also unchanged.

A 13F is a delayed quarterly holdings report, not a live trading record: it excludes cash and some other assets and does not identify who made each investment decision.

Source: https://t.co/uTxh6PxJUq
